ecosystemPurpose.role: This app is the front-end shell and working interface for the Applied Intelligence ecosystem, currently centered around AI-Trace with visible handoff into AI-CIS and dashboard-style management views.
boundaryNotes: Use AI-Trace to expose the pattern first.
Use AI-CIS when repetition becomes a process problem.

newestAddition.name: AI-Connect
newestAddition.role: Communication, routing, notification, permission, meeting-preparation, escalation, handoff, and broadcast layer across the Applied Intelligence ecosystem.

ecosystemAgents.siblingBoundaryRule: One ecosystem. Separate agents. Clear roles.

ruleSet: The app source should inherit its core ecosystem logic from the master Applied Intelligence source.
The app should not maintain conflicting agent definitions.
App-specific UI structure and PWA behavior can be app-specific, but core agent identity should stay aligned with the master source.
AI-Connect should be treated as umbrella-layer connective infrastructure, not as a replacement for sibling agents.
syncRules.corePrinciple: The app operates the ecosystem, but the master source defines it.
